IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.objects O JOIN sys.schemas S ON O.schema_id = S.schema_id WHERE O.NAME = '[FACT_RESULTADOS_EXAMENES]' AND O.TYPE = 'U' AND S.NAME = ' [dbo]')
CREATE TABLE  [dbo].[FACT_RESULTADOS_EXAMENES]
	(
	 [ID_FACT_RE] int,
	 [ID_SOLICITUD_EXAMEN_OLTP] bigint,
	 [IdDIMTIEMPO] int,
	 [ID_DIMPACIENTE] int,
	 [ID_DIMMEDICO] int,
	 [ID_DIMEXAMENES] int,
	 [VALOR_RESULTADO] numeric(10,2)
	)
WITH
	(
	DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
	 CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
	 -- HEAP
	)
GO

--Uncomment the 4 lines below to create a stored procedure for data pipeline orchestration​
--CREATE PROC bulk_load_[FACT_RESULTADOS_EXAMENES]
--AS
--BEGIN
COPY INTO  [dbo].[FACT_RESULTADOS_EXAMENES]
(ID_FACT_RE 1, ID_SOLICITUD_EXAMEN_OLTP 2, IdDIMTIEMPO 3, ID_DIMPACIENTE 4, ID_DIMMEDICO 5, ID_DIMEXAMENES 6, VALOR_RESULTADO 7)
FROM 'https://azpaciencareetl.dfs.core.windows.net/datosprocesados/dw/facr_resultados_examenes.parquet'
WITH
(
	FILE_TYPE = 'PARQUET'
	,MAXERRORS = 0
)
--END
GO

SELECT TOP 100 * FROM  [dbo].[FACT_RESULTADOS_EXAMENES]
GO
